I found two reasonable ways to handle the proration:
- **A:** charge the difference immediately
- **B:** credit it to the next invoice
A is simpler and matches what Stripe does by default. B avoids surprise charges. Which one do you want?

Customers were charged twice when they double-clicked Pay. The button stayed enabled until the response arrived.
I'm disabling it on submit and also adding an idempotency key on the server so a retry can't create a second charge.

The layout shift came from the web font loading late. The fallback font has a taller line height, so the hero text jumped by 6px when the real font swapped in.
I set `size-adjust` and `ascent-override` on the fallback `@font-face`, so both fonts occupy the same space.
